import ast,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
for name in ["scripts/ci/check-analyzer-framing.py","scripts/ci/tests/test_analyzer_framing_runner.py"]:
 ast.parse(Path(name).read_text(),filename=name)
p=Path(".github/workflows/verify.yml")
current=p.read_text()
start=current.index("      - name: Accepted standalone analyzer fixture framing\n")
end=current.index("      - name: Generated capability schema and host lifecycle\n",start)
base=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:.github/workflows/verify.yml"],text=True)
if current[:start]+current[end:] != base: raise RuntimeError("Existing workflow commands differ")
print(json.dumps({"python_syntax":"passed","existing_workflow_unchanged":True,"new_step_block_sha256":hashlib.sha256(current[start:end].encode()).hexdigest(),"base_workflow_sha256":hashlib.sha256(base.encode()).hexdigest()}))
